name: Spam Comment Remover
author: sahildadwal

sections.description:
Spam Comment Remover is a lightweight plugin that:

  • Deletes spam comments before they are saved
  • Blocks comments with links, gibberish, or foreign scripts
  • Removes fake author names or disposable emails
  • Cleans all pending and spam comments in dashboard
  • Removes “Website” field from comment form
  • No setup needed. Just activate and you’re done.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Done — no setup needed.
sections.changelog:
3.1

  • Improved detection for Cyrillic, Chinese, Arabic characters
  • Deletes pending + spam comments automatically
  • Shows activation message

short_description: Automatically removes spam comments. Blocks fake names, links, gibberish, non-English content. No setup — just activate and relax.
